ai.title: Add Android ad signals and placement slots to common
ai.summary: The common package introduces Android-specific ad instrumentation, including a new `android` object in the ad client context schema that captures device states like battery and orientation. `common/src/ads/android-placements.ts` registers two new inline slots, `Android-Chat-After-Assistant-Message` and `Android-Coding-After-Assistant-Message`, into the global placement registry. A consent gate in `android-ad-signals.ts` restricts these signals based on country and user choice, applying an ePrivacy-compliant rule where data collection is blocked outside of `granted` consent within the EEA/UK region. The engagement schema also gains a `landing` block to record post-click activity in Android Custom Tabs.
ai.evidence: New files `common/src/ads/android-ad-signals.ts`, `common/src/ads/android-placements.ts`, and `common/src/ads/mobile-placements.ts` define Android ad consent rules, placement slots, and surface helpers; `common/src/types/ad-client-context.ts` adds an `android` block and `landing` object to the Zod schemas.

eli5.text: The shared rules for the Freebuff Android app now define two new ad spaces that appear after an assistant answers in the chat or coding views. These spaces join the official list of ad slots, keeping them separate from other platforms to ensure accurate tracking. The app also includes a new set of privacy checks that allow it to read basic phone details, like battery level, only when you live in certain European countries and explicitly agree to it. In daily use, you may see these new ad spaces on your phone, but the service itself has not yet launched the feature, so there is no visible change until the app updates.

ai.title: Fix Freebuff wallet bonus retirement semantics on upgrade
ai.summary: The documentation for the `FreebuffFreebucksWallet` interface in the shared session types was corrected to clarify that a plan's monthly bonus is not retired when a user upgrades their subscription. Previously, the comment implied that the bonus would be retired when any subsequent period's bonus was credited, including during an upgrade. The update explicitly states that retirement occurs when the next month's bonus is credited, excluding the upgrade scenario.
ai.evidence: In `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`, the doc comment for `FreebuffFreebucksWallet` was changed from stating that monthly bonuses are retired 'when another period’s bonus is credited, including on upgrade' to 'when the next month’s bonus is credited, but not on an upgrade'.

eli5.text: The instructions for handling a paid plan's monthly bonus were corrected to clarify when that bonus expires. This rule applies to anyone who has upgraded their subscription from one paid plan to a higher one. The bonus is no longer discarded during an upgrade; instead, it only disappears when the next regular monthly bonus is added at the end of that month.
